CHARGE 'N' GO USB-C RECHARGEABLE BATTERIES

Hello,

Verbatim's new Charge 'n' Go rechargeable AA and AAA batteries are now available from Randmar.

Designed for modern electronics, these batteries recharge directly through USB-C - no separate battery charger required.

KEY BENEFITS

 * Up to 1,200 recharge cycles
 * LED charging-status indicator
 * Advanced safety protection
 * Four-battery pack with a 4-in-1 USB-C charging cable
